c176.name: Meteor
c176.lore: A meteor is the visible passage of a meteoroid through an atmosphere. Friction turns its descent into light, while the surviving mass may reach the ground as a meteorite.
c176.sig_desc: A streak of ionized gas marks a piece of space meeting a world.
c176.playstyle: An impersonal event of speed and gravity
c176.ability: A meteoroid becomes luminous when atmospheric ablation excites the surrounding air.

c177.name: Planetary Defense Grid
c177.lore: A planetary defense grid is a network of sensors, tracking systems, and interceptors built to detect threats before they reach a inhabited world. Its strength is coordination across distance.
c177.quote: The world below gets another minute.
str: Combines many systems into one response
wk: A blind spot can defeat the network
c177.sig_desc: A tracked object meets a guided response beyond the atmosphere.
c177.playstyle: A patient guardian of a fragile world
c177.ability: A fictional defense network uses orbital assets to detect and intercept incoming objects.

c178.name: Black Hole
c178.lore: A black hole is a region of spacetime whose gravity prevents anything that crosses its event horizon from escaping. Matter outside it can form a luminous accretion disk while the hole itself remains dark.
str: Can power a bright accretion disk
wk: Its interior is hidden beyond the horizon
Evaporation is unimaginably slow for stellar holes
c178.sig_desc: The boundary where escape would require moving faster than light.
c178.playstyle: A patient force of spacetime rather than a thinking being
c178.ability: A black hole curves spacetime so strongly that the event horizon becomes a one-way boundary.

c179.name: Rudeus Greyrat
c179.lore: Rudeus Greyrat is a shut-in reborn in a world of magic, determined to use a second life better than the first. Under Roxy's teaching he becomes an exceptional mage, while his family, friends, and the mana catastrophe force him to grow beyond talent.
c179.quote: I will not waste this life.
wk: Carries deep social and personal trauma
c179.sig_desc: A compressed earth spell refined through control, range, and destructive force.
c179.ability: Rudeus is known for silent casting and advanced elemental magic, especially his Stone Cannon.

rivals.rel: a terrifying turning point in his journey

c180.name: Prince Lloyd
c180.lore: Lloyd de Saloum is reborn as the seventh prince and treats magic as the one subject worthy of total attention. His curiosity, immense talent, and willingness to test dangerous theories make him brilliant, troublesome, and impossible to discourage.
wk: Treats danger as a research opportunity
c180.sig_desc: A spell is taken apart, understood, and rebuilt beyond its original limits.
c180.ability: Lloyd's defining talent is the obsessive study and refinement of magical techniques.

c181.name: Motoko Kusanagi
c181.rank: Ghost in the Shell · Section 9 commander
c181.lore: Motoko Kusanagi is a full-body cyborg and the field commander of Japan's Public Security Section 9. She moves between physical and networked space while questioning what remains of a person when the body, memories, and identity can all be engineered.
c181.quote: The net is vast and infinite.
str: Comfortable in both physical and digital combat
wk: Her body and memories can be compromised
c181.sig_desc: A conscious descent into a network where information and identity share one space.
c181.playstyle: A disciplined investigator of the human-machine boundary
c181.ability: Motoko's signature capabilities come from her cyberbrain, prosthetic body, and network infiltration skills.

rivals.rel: a crisis of consciousness and identity

c182.name: Xenomorph Queen
c182.lore: The Xenomorph Queen is the reproductive center of an alien hive, an immense organism that produces the next generation and defends its nest with terrifying force. Her intelligence is strategic rather than human, expressed through pheromones, instinct, and absolute control of the colony's survival.
wk: Protects the nest above all else
Reproduction binds her to the hive
c182.sig_desc: A living colony turns every death around the nest into another body.
c182.playstyle: A biological engine of sacrifice and relentless growth
c182.ability: The Xenomorph Queen produces and directs the organisms that make an alien hive.

rivals.rel: survivor who refuses to let the hive spread
the colony she creates and protects

c183.name: Naruto
c183.lore: Naruto Uzumaki begins as an outcast and grows into a leader capable of carrying the hopes of entire nations. His shadow clones, Rasengan, bond with Kurama, and Six Paths power turn persistence into world-changing strength.
c183.quote: I never go back on my word.
wk: Compassion leaves him open to manipulation
c183.sig_desc: One fighter becomes a formation of solid copies that share experience and overwhelm a battlefield.
c183.playstyle: A relentless leader who turns one fighter into a whole formation
c183.ability: Naruto's signature Shadow Clone Technique creates solid copies that share his experience and overwhelm a battlefield.

rivals.rel: the beast who becomes his partner
the war-born threat he helps stop

c184.name: Frieren
c184.lore: Frieren is an elven mage whose long life lets her study magic across centuries. After the Hero Himmel's journey ends, she begins a new journey of understanding, collecting spells, remembering people, and learning what brief human lives mean to her.
c184.quote: I want to learn a spell.
c184.sig_desc: A once-lethal demon spell becomes a familiar tool through patient analysis and mastery.
c184.playstyle: A patient archivist whose power grows through knowledge
c184.ability: Frieren's magic combines immense experience, precise analysis, and a collection of spells gathered over a long life.

rivals.rel: the hero whose memory reshapes her journey
the teacher who hides her power from demons
the apprentice who keeps her moving forward

c185.name: Guts
c185.lore: Guts is a mercenary who survives betrayal, war, and the designs of monsters through stubborn strength and relentless skill. The Dragonslayer and the Berserker Armor let him challenge apostles, but every victory extracts a physical and emotional price.
c185.sig_desc: A great iron sword made for monsters becomes the answer to anything that stands in his path.
c185.playstyle: A wounded survivor who becomes stronger when the world closes in
c185.ability: Guts fights with the Dragonslayer, a cannon arm, and a will that keeps moving after ordinary endurance is gone.

rivals.rel: friend and betrayer at the center of his trauma
the person he protects through the darkness
an apostle who recognises his strength

r001.name: The Holy Grail
r001.lore: The Holy Grail is a sacred vessel whose identity changes across medieval romances and later tradition. In Arthurian stories it becomes the object of a quest that tests purity, courage, and spiritual insight rather than simple strength.
r001.quote: The road matters as much as the cup.
str: Calls for the highest kind of quest
wk: Its location is unreachable by ordinary means
The quest can expose the seeker's unworthiness
r001.sig_desc: A sacred search that turns a knight's character into the measure of success.
r001.playstyle: An elusive symbol of grace and fulfillment
r001.ability: The Grail is traditionally associated with sacred nourishment, revelation, and the test of the worthy seeker.

rivals.rel: the pure knight who finds it
the court whose knights pursue it
a Christian origin in later tradition

r002.name: Lostvayne
r002.lore: Lostvayne is the sacred treasure of Meliodas, a short demon sword tied to his fighting style and the power of reflected magic. It represents the captain's violent history as much as his skill and loyalty to the Seven Deadly Sins.
str: Carries the weight of Meliodas's past
wk: Its power is tied to its wielder
r002.sig_desc: The sacred treasure multiplies its wielder's presence at the price of divided power.
r002.playstyle: A personal weapon shaped by a demon captain's restraint
r002.ability: Lostvayne is Meliodas's sacred treasure and enables his physical clone technique.

rivals.rel: the origin of his demonic legacy

r003.name: One Ring
r003.lore: The One Ring is Sauron's instrument of domination, forged in the fires of Orodruin to control the other Rings of Power. Its promise of strength is inseparable from corruption, and its destruction requires returning it to the fire that made it.
r003.quote: One Ring to rule them all.
str: Grants invisibility to a mortal wearer
Amplifies the will of its master
wk: Can be destroyed only in its forging fire
r003.sig_desc: A promise of power turns the bearer's own desire into the road home.
r003.playstyle: A beautiful object that makes possession a moral crisis
r003.ability: The One Ring grants invisibility and magnifies the power of its maker, while corrupting its bearer.

r005.name: Infinity Stone
r005.lore: An Infinity Stone is one of six primordial crystals formed at the beginning of the universe. Each embodies a fundamental aspect of existence, and together they can reshape life on a cosmic scale.
r005.quote: The universe is written in six laws.
str: Can be wielded on a cosmic scale
wk: Its power can destroy its wielder
Concentration of the Stones invites conquest
r005.sig_desc: The six Stones act together to turn a thought into a universal event.
r005.playstyle: A cosmic artifact whose meaning depends on which force it contains
r005.ability: The six Infinity Stones govern Space, Mind, Reality, Power, Time, and Soul in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

rivals.rel: collector who seeks the complete set
beings shaped by the same cosmic history

r006.name: White Whistle
r006.lore: A White Whistle is the relic of a legendary cave raider, made from a human life and recognized by the Abyss as a symbol of authority. It grants access to the deepest layers while binding exploration to sacrifice.
r006.quote: The Abyss answers the brave and the cruel alike.
str: Marks the highest rank of delver
Opens the path to deeper layers
Carries the will of a sacrificed person
wk: Authority does not protect against the curse
r006.sig_desc: A whistle made from a life gives its owner permission to descend farther.
r006.playstyle: A badge of wonder, horror, and irreversible commitment
r006.ability: White Whistles are made from human souls and identify the highest-ranked cave raiders in Made in Abyss.

rivals.rel: a White Whistle whose experiments redefine sacrifice

r007.name: Chamber of Secrets
r007.lore: The Chamber of Secrets is a hidden chamber beneath Hogwarts built by Salazar Slytherin. It contains a Basilisk and can be opened by the heir of Slytherin through Parseltongue, turning an old prejudice into a living threat.
r007.sig_desc: A serpent older than the school rises when the hidden language is spoken.
r007.playstyle: A secret legacy that turns fear into architecture
r007.ability: The Chamber houses Salazar Slytherin's Basilisk and opens through the heir's Parseltongue.

r008.name: Cyber-Enchantment
r008.lore: Cyber-Enchantment is the old fantasy dream translated into circuitry: a ward encoded as a living protocol, a spell that travels through a network instead of a ley line.
str: Marries symbolic magic with systems thinking
wk: A corrupted network corrupts the spell
The interface can obscure the human cost
r008.sig_desc: An arcane boundary becomes a defensive loop around a connected mind.
r008.playstyle: A speculative bridge between ritual and code
r008.ability: Cyber-enchantment is a fantasy archetype in which magical wards are expressed through technology and networks.

r009.name: Ea
r009.lore: Ea is the ancient sword wielded by Gilgamesh in the Fate series. Its rotating body represents the primordial separation of heaven and earth, and its Noble Phantasm, Enuma Elish, tears at the world's texture.
str: Belongs to the King of Heroes
Its attack is conceptual as well as physical
wk: Its greatest release is difficult to control
r009.sig_desc: The Sword of Rupture rotates against the world and recreates the memory of its separation.
r009.playstyle: A king's relic that treats reality as an artifact
r009.ability: Ea is Gilgamesh's Noble Phantasm, and Enuma Elish is its anti-world release.

rivals.rel: another king who challenges his pride

r010.name: Elder wand
r010.lore: The Elder Wand is one of the three Deathly Hallows, made by Death in the tale told to the Peverell brothers. Its reputation as the most powerful wand makes allegiance more important than possession.
str: Carries the myth of unbeatable skill
wk: Can be won without being stolen
A wand is not a substitute for judgment
r010.sig_desc: The wand's true loyalty follows defeat, not the hand that simply takes it.
r010.playstyle: A legendary instrument whose power creates its own temptation
r010.ability: The Elder Wand is unusually powerful, but its allegiance passes to the person who defeats its master.

rivals.rel: last wielder in the Hallows story

r011.name: Monster Cell
r011.lore: Monster Cells are created by the Monster Association to transform humans into monsters. Eating one can unlock a person's suppressed obsession, but the change usually means surrendering human identity for power.
r011.quote: What would you become to win?
str: Reflects the psychology of its host
wk: The result depends on the host
Power brings no guarantee of purpose
r011.sig_desc: An appetite or obsession is given a body large enough to rule the person who had it.
r011.playstyle: A dangerous shortcut from frustration to identity
r011.ability: Monster Cells transform humans into monsters by amplifying their desires and physical potential.

rivals.rel: Monster King shaped by the Association
a human who pursues monsterization by another path
the human ideal the monsters cannot understand

r012.name: Philosopher's Stone
r012.lore: The Philosopher's Stone is an alchemical object capable of producing the Elixir of Life and turning any metal into pure gold. In the wizarding world it is made by Nicolas Flamel, whose long life becomes inseparable from the stone's fate.
r012.quote: There are other ways to live forever.
str: Represents the height of alchemical craft
Turns transformation into a literal object
wk: The maker must choose when to destroy it
r012.sig_desc: A red draught postpones death while the stone remains in the world.
r012.playstyle: A quiet answer to the fantasy of immortality
r012.ability: The Philosopher's Stone creates the Elixir of Life and transmutes base metals into gold.

rivals.rel: would use it to escape death

r013.name: Allspark Cube
r013.lore: The AllSpark is the source of life for the Transformers and the object at the center of Cybertronian creation myths. It can awaken machines, sustain a civilization, and become the prize that turns Optimus Prime and Megatron against one another.
str: Carries the history of a world
wk: It is vulnerable when removed from Cybertron
Creation does not prevent civil war
r013.sig_desc: A source of living energy gives metal a mind, a voice, and a choice.
r013.playstyle: A creation myth in mechanical form
r013.ability: The AllSpark gives life to Transformers and is central to Cybertronian creation in the franchise.

rivals.rel: would use it to remake the world
one of the lives it helps preserve

r014.name: Anti-magic Mask
r014.origin: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
r014.lore: The anti-magic mask is worn by Shizue Izawa, the Otherworlder known as Shizu. It suppresses magical energy and becomes part of the mystery surrounding the people and worlds that shaped her life.
str: Connects Shizu to a wider history
wk: The mask cannot heal its wearer
Its meaning depends on Shizu's past
r014.sig_desc: A mask turns overwhelming power into something a human body can carry.
r014.playstyle: A symbol of restraint, memory, and borrowed identity
r014.ability: Shizu's anti-magic mask suppresses magical energy and is associated with her Otherworlder history.

rivals.rel: connected to Shizu's summoning and past

r015.name: Devil Fruit
r015.lore: A Devil Fruit grants its eater a strange ability, but takes away the ability to swim. The fruits range from elemental powers to transformations, and their deepest mysteries connect to the lost history of the world.
str: Gives one person a singular ability
Allows wildly different forms of expression
Some powers awaken into greater states
wk: Only one person can normally hold its power at a time
r015.sig_desc: A Devil Fruit power reaches beyond its original host and changes the world around it.
r015.playstyle: A gift whose freedom always carries a maritime cost
r015.ability: Devil Fruits grant supernatural powers, while seawater and Seastone weaken their users in One Piece.

r016.name: Healing Potion
r016.lore: The healing potion is a recurring fantasy image: a bottle of concentrated restoration carried by adventurers, soldiers, and hedge wizards. Its meaning is simple, but its ingredients reveal the healer's culture and craft.
str: Can be brewed by many traditions
wk: Ingredients may be rare or poisonous
A potion cannot undo every wound
r016.sig_desc: A small bottle carries the promise that damage does not have to be permanent.
r016.playstyle: A humble symbol of preparation and mercy
r016.ability: Healing potions are fantasy medicines that restore vitality through magical or alchemical ingredients.

r017.name: Queen's Cocoon
r017.lore: The Chimera Ant Queen's nest is a place of feeding, growth, and violent evolution. The Queen produces offspring by consuming living creatures, and the colony's future emerges from the bodies and traits brought into the nest.
r017.quote: The next generation is already moving.
str: Produces the Royal Guards and King
wk: The Queen is bound to reproduction
r017.sig_desc: A body formed from many lives emerges carrying the potential of a species.
r017.playstyle: A biological engine of hunger, hierarchy, and transformation
r017.ability: The Chimera Ant Queen produces offspring by consuming creatures and passing their traits into the colony.

rivals.rel: the King born from the Queen
Royal Guard of the next generation
the human bond that changes the King

r018.name: Shinigami Eyes
r018.lore: The Shinigami Eyes let a human see the name and remaining lifespan of another person. The price is half the human's remaining life, paid to a Shinigami in exchange for the sight.
wk: Knowledge can destroy the person who uses it
r018.sig_desc: A bargain trades years of life for the ability to see the truth written above a person.
r018.playstyle: A forbidden shortcut through identity and death
r018.ability: A human with Shinigami Eyes sees names and lifespans after accepting the Shinigami's price.

rivals.rel: uses the deal as part of Kira's plans
Shinigami observer of the human world

r019.name: The Green Mask
r019.epithet: The Face of Pure Cartoon Chaos
r019.lore: The Mask is a supernatural green face associated with Loki that releases the wearer's suppressed impulses. It turns Stanley Ipkiss into the elastic, fourth-wall-breaking Big Head, with reality bending around comic instinct.
wk: Removing the mask removes the transformation
r019.sig_desc: A timid person becomes an animated force of impossible gags and elastic physics.
r019.playstyle: A comic identity that makes inhibition physically disappear
r019.ability: The Mask grants cartoon-like reality manipulation while amplifying the wearer's suppressed personality.

r020.name: Tesseract
r020.lore: The Tesseract is the crystalline containment vessel for the Space Stone in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. It powers the research of Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S., opens portals, and becomes a prize for the Red Skull, Loki, and Thanos.
str: Contains one of the Infinity Stones
wk: The container does not control the Stone
Human experiments cannot safely master it
r020.sig_desc: A blue gateway turns distance into a door and lets the universe arrive at once.
r020.playstyle: A cosmic container mistaken for a manageable machine
r020.ability: The Tesseract contains the Space Stone and enables portal travel in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

rivals.rel: steals it for the Chitauri invasion
first modern seeker of its power

r021.name: Infinity Castle
r021.lore: The Infinity Castle is the shifting extradimensional stronghold of Muzan Kibutsuji. Nakime controls its rooms with her biwa, moving demons and intruders through impossible distances as the Demon Slayer Corps closes in.
str: Rewrites the architecture of a battlefield
Makes distance meaningless inside the castle
wk: Muzan's command is the castle's purpose
It offers no refuge from the outside world
r021.sig_desc: One plucked string rearranges the fortress and sends every traveler somewhere else.
r021.playstyle: A living maze shaped by a demon's instrument
r021.ability: Nakime's Blood Demon Art controls the Infinity Castle and rearranges its rooms through her biwa.

rivals.rel: Demon Slayer who enters its final battle

r022.name: Pandora's Box
r022.epithet: The Jar of What Was Unleashed
r022.lore: Pandora's Box is more accurately a jar in the earliest Greek account. Zeus sends Pandora to humanity, and when the jar is opened, evils escape into the world while Hope remains inside or arrives last, depending on the reading.
r022.quote: Curiosity opens what fear keeps closed.
str: Preserves Hope as a final mystery
Endures as a warning about curiosity
wk: The story's details vary by translation
Pandora is blamed for a divine punishment
Hope's place inside the jar remains ambiguous
r022.sig_desc: One irreversible motion turns hidden possibility into the condition of the world.
r022.playstyle: A myth about blame, knowledge, and the survival of hope
r022.ability: Pandora's jar releases the world's evils, while Hope remains as the story's contested final presence.

rivals.rel: the first woman and opener of the jar

r023.name: The Monkey's Paw
r023.lore: In W. W. Jacobs's short story, a mummified paw is said to grant three wishes. Sergeant-Major Morris warns the Whites about it, but the family wishes anyway and discovers that a fulfilled desire can arrive in the cruelest literal form.
r023.quote: Be careful what you wish for.
str: Turns ordinary wishes into moral tests
wk: The wisher cannot control the cost
Every wish deepens the family's grief
r023.sig_desc: The last wish is not a prize; it is an attempt to close the story the first two created.
r023.playstyle: A horror object built from regret and literal language
r023.ability: The paw grants three wishes whose outcomes twist the wisher's words into tragedy.

rivals.rel: brings the paw and warns the family
wisher whose grief drives the story
the loss behind the second wish

r024.name: Ark of the Covenant
r024.lore: The Ark of the Covenant is the sacred chest described in the Hebrew Bible as the dwelling place of God's covenant with Israel. Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark turn its sacred imagery into an archaeological adventure about reverence and desecration.
wk: Must not be treated as ordinary treasure
Its power is dangerous when profaned
r024.sig_desc: The lid and cherubim mark a boundary between a sacred promise and human curiosity.
r024.playstyle: A holy object whose mystery resists possession
r024.ability: The Ark is associated with the tablets of the covenant and divine presence in biblical tradition.

rivals.rel: rival who treats it as a prize

r025.name: Necronomicon
r025.lore: The Necronomicon is a fictional grimoire created by H. P. Lovecraft and attributed to the mad poet Abdul Alhazred. Its fragments describe cosmic entities and rituals that make human knowledge feel small, temporary, and dangerous.
str: Infects every library that mentions it
r025.sig_desc: A page reveals a truth large enough to make the reader smaller.
r025.playstyle: A book-shaped breach in the limits of human understanding
r025.ability: The Necronomicon is a fictional occult book associated with Abdul Alhazred and the Cthulhu Mythos.

rivals.rel: one of the cosmic entities it invokes
modern horror hero who battles its derivatives

r026.name: Dragon Balls
r026.lore: The Dragon Balls are seven magical orbs that summon Shenron when gathered. Their wishes are limited by the dragon and the creator of the set, while the search for them carries the story from a comic adventure into cosmic history.
str: Turns a scattered search into a miracle
wk: The orbs scatter after a wish
r026.sig_desc: Seven lights gather, the dragon rises, and one request becomes history.
r026.playstyle: A journey object that makes hope a physical collection
r026.ability: Gathering the seven Dragon Balls summons Shenron, who grants a wish within his stated limits.

rivals.rel: dragon summoned by the complete set
finder who begins the original search
hero whose life grows around the orbs

r027.name: Mjolnir
r027.lore: Mjolnir is the enchanted hammer of Thor, forged in a dying star and marked by Odin's worthiness enchantment. It returns to its wielder, commands storms, and has been lifted by heroes who prove themselves worthy of its responsibility.
r027.quote: Whosoever holds this hammer, if they be worthy...
str: Returns when called by its worthy wielder
Makes worthiness a visible moral test
wk: Cannot be lifted by the unworthy
Its power is tied to responsibility
The enchantment can be changed by its creator
r027.sig_desc: The hammer answers the person who can carry its power without being ruled by it.
r027.playstyle: A weapon that measures character before strength
r027.ability: Mjolnir grants Thor control over storms and can be lifted only by those judged worthy by its enchantment.

r028.name: Excalibur
r028.epithet: The Sword of the Once and Future King
r028.lore: Excalibur is King Arthur's famous sword, usually given to him by the Lady of the Lake. Later retellings sometimes merge it with the sword drawn from the stone, but the legends consistently make it a sign of rightful kingship and a weapon beyond ordinary craft.
r028.quote: The right hand finds the hilt.
str: Unites Arthur's rule with mythic destiny
wk: The sword cannot preserve a failing kingdom
Its legend depends on Arthur's character
r028.sig_desc: A blade rises from the lake as a sign that kingship can be granted, not merely seized.
r028.playstyle: A symbol of authority that outlives the person who carries it
r028.ability: Excalibur is Arthur's enchanted sword, associated with the Lady of the Lake and the king's legitimacy.

r029.name: Omnitrix
r029.lore: The Omnitrix is a device created by Azmuth that lets its wearer access the genetic templates of many alien species. It was designed as a tool for understanding and peace, but its range of forms makes it one of the most dangerous objects in the galaxy.
str: Stores a library of alien forms
Makes knowledge a source of power
wk: The watch can choose the wrong form
Its creator fears what others would do with it
r029.sig_desc: A flash of green light opens a new body and a new answer to the problem in front of it.
r029.playstyle: A device of endless adaptation and imperfect control
r029.ability: The Omnitrix allows its user to transform into sampled alien species while preserving a path back to human form.

r030.name: Stand Arrow
r030.lore: The Stand Arrows are mysterious weapons made from a meteorite carrying an otherworldly virus. Those who survive the piercing may awaken a Stand, while those who cannot endure it are left behind by the same force that grants another person extraordinary power.
str: Turns a wound into a new identity
Links separate lives to one mystery
wk: Power depends on the person's response
r030.sig_desc: A single point of contact divides an ordinary life from the strange ability waiting beneath it.
r030.playstyle: A dangerous gamble that rewards those who endure transformation
r030.ability: The Stand Arrow can awaken a supernatural Stand in someone who survives its power.

rivals.rel: seeker of the Arrow's final evolution

r031.name: Poké Ball
r031.lore: A Poké Ball is a compact device used to carry Pokémon between journeys and battles. Its small shape hides a carefully tuned interior, turning a powerful creature's movement between the wild and a trainer's side into a familiar red-and-white gesture.
str: Holds more than its size suggests
wk: The device is only useful with trust
Not every species fits the same ball
r031.sig_desc: A red flash folds a travelling partner into a safe capsule until the next call to action.
r031.playstyle: A simple tool built around trust, timing, and return
r031.ability: Poké Balls allow trainers to capture, carry, and call their Pokémon partners during a journey.

rivals.rel: trainer whose partners define his journey
researcher of Pokémon and their habitats
powerful being that resists human control

r032.name: Time Turner
r032.lore: A Time-Turner is a magical hourglass that lets its user revisit a limited span of time. Hermione Granger uses one to attend overlapping lessons, and later stories show how even a small change in chronology can carry enormous consequences.
r032.sig_desc: Sand falls upward for a moment, returning a wound to the instant before it was made.
r032.playstyle: A precise answer to damage that depends on remembering when it began
r032.ability: A Time-Turner allows a witch or wizard to revisit a recent period of time through a charmed hourglass.

rivals.rel: student who uses one to manage her studies

r033.name: Symbiote
r033.lore: A symbiote is a living alien organism that bonds with a host and shares its senses, strength, and instincts. The relationship can become a partnership like Venom and Eddie Brock, or a struggle in which hunger and identity threaten to consume the person inside the suit.
wk: Fire and sound can hurt it
r033.sig_desc: When the host should fall, the living suit holds the body together for one more struggle.
r033.playstyle: A dangerous partnership that converts survival into dependence
r033.ability: Marvel symbiotes bond with hosts to grant strength, healing, and a shared identity at a personal cost.

rivals.rel: host who forms the Venom partnership
first human host of the black suit
creator and god of the symbiotes

r034.name: Neuralyzer
r034.lore: The neuralyzer is a compact device used by the Men in Black to erase or replace memories with a flash of light. It keeps the hidden alien world from becoming public knowledge, while leaving its agents responsible for deciding which truths ordinary people are allowed to remember.
wk: Memory is not the same as understanding
r034.sig_desc: A white pulse clears the mental residue of curses, fear, and unwanted control.
r034.playstyle: A quiet reset button for a battlefield full of lingering consequences
r034.ability: Men in Black agents use neuralyzers to erase or alter memories and preserve secrecy after supernatural encounters.

rivals.rel: veteran agent who carries the device
partner learning the cost of secrecy
